method.exactName: Case/whitespace-normalized observation taxon names; not image inspection.
method.aliases: Only explicitly reported source synonyms, alternate spellings or headings; historical applications are excluded from equivalence.
method.descendants: Separate count where a recorded target taxon ID occurs in the observation ancestor_ids; excludes exact/alias counts.
method.splitCheck: Manifest freeze SHA and no exact content, normalized pixel, observation, photo, observer or split-group crossing partitions.

limitations: This is dataset label coverage, not species recognition accuracy or verified image content.
The classifier is trained on broad entry classes, not each named species.
A photo count of one or a few is presence evidence only; no species accuracy threshold is established.
Global observation taxa are not a Michigan-only inventory.
Entoloma abortivum aborted form, chaga growth form, specimen condition and other eligibility constraints are not annotated.
Open-genus study coverage cannot be converted to a complete species checklist by this dataset.
Morel historical name applications and ringless honey taxonomy are not silently equated.
All guesses still require human review; no edibility or sales approval is inferred.
